text: The purpose of this report is to remove one director from the Mount Pleasant Village Business Improvement Area (BIA) Board of Management. The Mount Pleasant Village BIA falls within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, remove the following director from the Mount Pleasant Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below: Laurie Hillesheim
